deep.surprise_reason: The page is a personal scratch cover: itineraries, pace counts, expenses, a famous quotation and isolated astronomical numbers. It contains no new mathematics. Gauss's habit of pacing and timing distances, and his Harz and Göttingen trips of the period, are well documented.

transcription_corrections: 'Hoppenstedter Thurm' is likely a tower near Hondelage/Hoppenstedt on the Helmstedt road; reading uncertain.
'Kremling' should be read Cremlingen; 'Appenrode' is Abbenrode; 'Helmstadt' is Helmstedt.
'Nacwert' is probably a name or word partially overwritten ('Nacwert'/'Nachwert'); illegible.
'ws why why' near the epitaph is likely an alternative or variant-word note, not part of Pope's text.
In the expense list 'Rosenthal[?]' may be 'Reinhardswald'/'Rosdorf' – uncertain; 'Einbeck[?]' entry has a struck-out 6 replaced by 6.
'Innerer Wolf. Th.' means 'Innerer Wolfenbütteler Thor' (Wolfenbüttel gate), and 'O.M. Brücke' is probably 'Okermühlen-Brücke' or similar.
